affected_condition: Extraction by gpgtar into a directory containing pre-existing symlinks
reason: Exact API image does not contain /usr/bin/gpgtar. Fixed API entrypoint/health/lifecycle do not invoke gpgtar; archive maintenance is in separate tools image using Python tarfile, not GnuPG tar extraction.
limitations: Exact immutable reference image and supported command graph only.
Arbitrary Python modules/operator scripts, XML parsing features, new archive commands, or added gpgtar package require reassessment.
Python XML parsers are available; this does not claim their entropy vulnerability is fixed.
